_about: Monochrome Cinema variant from Top-100 rank 49 (daez.visuals, 37 s; a monitor-filmed showcase of a vertical edit: we template the EDIT on the monitor, not the monitor framing). Warm amber/yellow-lit room, speaker in colour; captions are compact, tightly-stacked mixed stacks: bold white sans words with a serif-italic or handwriting word laid over them ('you keep working hard on your craft', 'taking steps'), mixed case, sitting mid-frame on the chest (~45-55% down). Cutaways: moody colour lifestyle b-roll (hooded figure, desk at night, notebook) rather than B&W stock. Smaller heroes than the family: the stack reads as one block. Measure caveat: loop/measure.py sees the MONITOR shot, not the edit (1.6 changes/min, one 36 s calm, -7.7 LUFS room mic, face 10% of frame), so its numbers are not a target. Settings come from the frames: the inner edit cuts every ~3 s, captions sit mid-chest of the inner frame.

director.style: Monochrome Cinema (amber stack): warm amber room, compact white stacks mixing bold sans with a serif-italic or handwritten word. Do NOT recreate the monitor/Premiere framing of the reference; that was only how the creator filmed it.
director.captions: captions.heroes: one hero per phrase. captions.serif: about a third of the heroes (the feeling words: 'happening', 'craft', 'headed'). captions.script: 1-2 words per reel in handwriting ('steps', 'hard'). Mixed case.
director.cutaways: 2-4 image scenes per 30 s, captions: true, 1.0-1.8 s, grade saturate(0.8) contrast(1.15) brightness(0.78): hooded figure, desk at night, notebook and pen, studio plant. Public domain / CC0 via stock_fetch.py.
director.rhythm: Picture change every ~2.5 s. Hard cuts.
